title: A budget that stays balanced
description: Changing one allocation redistributes the remaining budget across unlocked lines while the total stays exact.
useCase: Edit production budgets, capacity or category weights with a fixed total and protected allocations.
interaction: Drag an allocation or use its arrow keys. Lock a line to preserve it while other amounts redistribute; Escape cancels the whole drag.
reducedMotion: Pointer edits track directly; keyboard, reduced-motion and inactive-host changes have no settle transition. Pausing cancels a pending transaction and disables controls.
limitations: Local integer budget fixture in thousands of dollars. Changing line count, total or minimum resets allocations; an infeasible minimum is capped at floor(total / count). No persistence or financial service integration.
look: A dominant cobalt, silver and graphite allocation ribbon with large percentages, a quiet monetary total and a compact two-column set of fine sliders and lock icons.
motion: Dragging a handle transfers money between the unlocked lines while the total and protected values stay fixed. Large unscaled percentage labels follow the changing segment centers; neighboring rails and the allocation ribbon settle with transforms. Every slider keeps the same scale when locks change.
adapt: `distribute` preserves the integer total using weighted largest-remainder allocation; `before` anchors each pointer transaction so reversing restores the original proportions. `seed` creates the fixture. Change `LINES` and `COLORS` for another domain. Keep the common slider scale, feasible bounds, Escape rollback and protected values. `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop configure bounds and settling.
